title.zh-CN: 反复痰中带血、发热 · 55岁女性
title.en: Recurrent blood-streaked sputum and fever · 55-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 55岁女性六年来反复咳嗽、痰中带血，每次用抗生素后好转又复发；这次发热入院，需要查清病因，并制定她能安全接受的治疗。
summary.en: A 55-year-old woman whose blood-streaked cough has kept coming back for six years, settling each time on antibiotics, is admitted with a fever: find the cause and plan treatment she can safely take.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——55岁女性；间断咳嗽、痰中带血6年，每年1–2次，以往约两周抗生素后缓解；20天前再发热、咳嗽，最高39℃，咳痰，轻度气促；本次莫西沙星后病灶缩小；青霉素和头孢类过敏（反应不详）；8年前右肺中叶切除，病理称肺结核，术后抗结核3个月；2型糖尿病4年；无吸烟史；入院体温38℃、血压115/70 mmHg，右肺局限性干啰音、左肺呼吸音清；CT初始右肺门约4.5 cm肿块，抗菌后缩小，停药后再发伴渗出；多次痰抗酸涂片、培养及其他所列感染检查阴性；首次支气管镜黏膜充血水肿、管腔狭窄，活检为炎性肉芽、坏死和细菌菌团，未见肿瘤细胞；复发后黄色颗粒堵塞支气管，硫磺颗粒周围放射状菌丝，革兰及银染阳性、抗酸及弱抗酸染色阴性，两次标本专科鉴定为放线菌；米诺环素因色素沉着和胃肠反应停用，改阿奇霉素6个月；病灶基本吸收伴轻度支气管扩张，停药后未再复发，随访时长不详——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计（入院、首轮结果、停药后复发、治疗期间、记录的转归；莫西沙星后缩小放在入院阶段，与 1.0.0 版一致）、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（其他生命体征、血液检查、过敏反应类型、药物剂量、CT细节和日期、培养与菌种、牙齿情况、随访时长）保持未知。1.0.0 版的几处表述差异（英文CT描述漏掉“右”、“两次标本”与“both specimens”、各次检查与莫西沙星疗程的先后）保留并列入导师指南的待核实清单。原文图组经审核获准，只在转归阶段展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 55-year-old woman; six years of intermittent cough with blood-streaked sputum, once or twice a year, each bout settling on about two weeks of antibiotics; fever and cough again 20 days earlier, up to 39 °C, with sputum and mild breathlessness; this time the lesion shrank after moxifloxacin; penicillin and cephalosporin allergies (reactions unspecified); a right middle lobectomy 8 years earlier reported as tuberculosis, with three months of TB treatment; type 2 diabetes for 4 years; no smoking history; temperature 38 °C and BP 115/70 mmHg on admission, localised rhonchi on the right and clear breath sounds on the left; on CT an initial right hilar mass of about 4.5 cm that shrank with antibiotics and recurred with infiltrates after they stopped; repeated sputum acid-fast smears, cultures and other listed infection tests negative; at the first bronchoscopy hyperaemic, oedematous mucosa with luminal narrowing and a biopsy of inflammatory granulation tissue, necrosis and bacterial colonies without tumour cells; after the relapse yellow granules blocking the bronchus, sulphur granules with radiating filaments, Gram- and silver-positive and negative on acid-fast and modified acid-fast stains, and Actinomyces identified on specialist review of the specimens from two occasions; minocycline stopped for pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects, then six months of azithromycin; the lesions largely resolved with mild bronchiectasis and no relapse after treatment stopped, over a follow-up of unrecorded length — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (admission, first results, relapse after the antibiotics stopped, on treatment, recorded outcome; the shrinkage on moxifloxacin is placed at admission, as in 1.0.0), decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (other vital signs, blood tests, the type of the allergic reactions, drug doses, CT details and dates, culture and species, dental health, the length of follow-up) stays unknown. Points where the 1.0.0 text differs with itself (the English CT text omits “right”; “两次标本” against “both specimens”; the order of the tests relative to the moxifloxacin course) are kept and listed in the facilitator guide's “To verify”. The report's figure group is approved and is shown only in the outcome phase.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对六年来同一部位反复发作、每次抗菌治疗后好转的中央型肺门肿块，列出伴阻塞性感染的肿瘤、结核和慢性细菌感染等鉴别诊断，并说明抗菌后缩小为何不能排除其中任何一种。
learningOutcomes.en: Build a differential for a central hilar mass that has recurred in the same place for six years and improved with every antibiotic course — a tumour with obstructive infection, tuberculosis, a chronic bacterial infection — and explain why shrinkage on antibiotics excludes none of them.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 再次抗菌治疗前先取证：按 ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 和 WHO 2025 送痰抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和快速分子检测，可能是结核时不用氟喹诺酮类做试验性治疗（ISTC 2014），中央型病灶首选支气管镜活检和灌洗（ACCP 2013）。
learningOutcomes.en: Sample before treating again: sputum acid-fast smear, mycobacterial culture and a rapid molecular test (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017; WHO 2025), no fluoroquinolone trial while TB is possible (ISTC 2014), and bronchoscopic biopsy and lavage for a central lesion (ACCP 2013).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释一次活检未见肿瘤细胞为何不能排除肿瘤，并用革兰、银染、抗酸和弱抗酸染色把放线菌与诺卡菌、真菌和分枝杆菌区分开，说出硫磺颗粒的意义。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why one biopsy without tumour cells does not exclude a tumour, and use Gram, silver, acid-fast and modified acid-fast stains to tell Actinomyces from Nocardia, fungi and mycobacteria, stating what sulphur granules mean.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对有青霉素和头孢类过敏标签、反应不明的患者，按 AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 结构化询问并转诊过敏评估，评估前不用β-内酰胺类，改用四环素类等有效替代药物。
learningOutcomes.en: For a patient with penicillin and cephalosporin labels of unknown type, take a structured allergy history and refer for assessment (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022), giving no β-lactam meanwhile and choosing an active alternative such as a tetracycline.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为放线菌病制定以月计的疗程（传统为6–12个月，Valour 2014），以症状和CT吸收决定停药；出现米诺环素色素沉着等不良反应时换用另一类有效药物，而不是提前停药。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan a months-long course for actinomycosis (traditionally 6–12 months; Valour 2014), stopping on clinical and CT resolution, and switch to another active class — rather than stop early — when adverse effects such as minocycline pigmentation appear.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用通俗的话向患者解释病情为什么反复、为什么要用几个月的药、为什么过敏标签需要评估，并用回授法确认她听懂了。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain to the patient in plain words why the illness kept coming back, why treatment lasts months and why her allergy labels need assessing, and check her understanding by teach-back.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽、痰里带血断断续续六年，这二十天又加重，还发烧
chiefComplaint.en: A cough with blood in my phlegm on and off for six years, worse these twenty days, with a fever

triageNote.zh-CN: 55岁女性，间断咳嗽、痰中带血6年，近20天加重，伴发热（最高39℃）、咳痰和轻度气促，收入病房。入院体温38℃，血压115/70 mmHg；自述对青霉素和头孢类过敏。
triageNote.en: 55-year-old woman admitted to the ward with six years of intermittent blood-streaked sputum, worse for 20 days with fever up to 39 °C, a productive cough and mild breathlessness. Temperature 38 °C and BP 115/70 mmHg on admission; she reports penicillin and cephalosporin allergies.

personality.zh-CN: 55岁女性，六年来咳嗽、痰中带血反反复复，每次用了抗生素好一阵又犯；这次发烧住院，心里着急。说话直接、配合，知道的都愿意说；不清楚的事就直说说不上来，从不猜。
personality.en: A 55-year-old woman whose blood-streaked cough has come and gone for six years, settling on antibiotics each time and then returning; admitted with a fever this time and worried. Direct and cooperative, she tells what she knows; when she does not know, she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子不长；药名照医生告诉她的说（莫西沙星、米诺环素、阿奇霉素），其余不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences; names the drugs as the doctors told her (moxifloxacin, minocycline, azithromycin), otherwise no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这咳嗽、痰里带血断断续续六年了，这回又发烧了。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've had this cough with blood in my phlegm on and off for six years, and now I've got a fever again.

concerns.zh-CN: 反反复复这么多年，是不是肺里长了不好的东西？
concerns.en: After all these years of it coming back — is something bad growing in my lung?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院时她发着烧、咳嗽有痰、稍有气短，但能坐着完整地说话，担心是肺里长了不好的东西。只说她自己知道的事：病程、以前和这次用过的药、八年前的手术、糖尿病、过敏的药名；不说检查数值和结果，不编造过敏反应的样子、用药剂量、牙齿情况、喝酒或家族史。治疗阶段她只知道医生告诉她的情况（色素沉着、胃肠不舒服、换了什么药）。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission she has a fever, a cough with phlegm and mild breathlessness, but can sit and talk in full sentences, and she fears something bad is growing in her lung. She tells only what she knows — the course, the antibiotics before and this time, the operation eight years ago, her diabetes, the names of the drugs she is allergic to — never test values or results, and never invents what her reactions looked like, doses, the state of her teeth, her drinking or her family history. In the treatment phase she knows only what the doctors told her (pigmentation, an upset stomach and bowels, the change of drug).

label.zh-CN: 入院：发热，痰中带血又发作
label.en: Admission: fever and another bout of blood-streaked sputum

description.zh-CN: 她因间断咳嗽、痰中带血6年，近20天加重伴发热收入病房。在床旁问诊、查体，调阅胸部CT报告，决定首轮检查。
description.en: She has been admitted with six years of intermittent blood-streaked sputum, worse for 20 days with fever. At the bedside: take the history, examine her, read the chest CT reports and decide on the first tests.

description.zh-CN: 痰检和首次支气管镜检查已经完成，结果陆续回报。
description.en: The sputum tests and a first bronchoscopy have been done, and the results are coming back.

description.zh-CN: 抗菌药停用后，病变又复发了。复查的CT和支气管镜已经做完。
description.en: After the antibiotics were stopped, the disease came back. The repeat CT and bronchoscopy have been done.

description.zh-CN: 按记录的病程，治疗用的是米诺环素；用药期间她出现色素沉着和胃肠反应，米诺环素已经停用。
description.en: In the recorded course the treatment was minocycline; while taking it she developed pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects, and it has been stopped.

description.zh-CN: 米诺环素停用之后的治疗、病灶的变化和随访：本病例记录的经过。
description.en: Treatment after the minocycline was stopped, how the lesions changed and follow-up, as this case records them.

source.en: Case presentation in the report: treatment and outcome (minocycline stopped for pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects, then 6 months of azithromycin; lesions largely resolved with mild bronchiectasis; no relapse after stopping; length of follow-up not given) (as extracted for version 1.0.0; check against the full article pending)

name.zh-CN: 排除结核前采取空气传播隔离
name.en: Airborne precautions until TB is excluded

dose.zh-CN: 单间（有条件时用负压病房），医护人员戴N95口罩，患者离开病房检查时戴外科口罩；至少3份痰涂片阴性或另行确诊后解除（CDC 2005）。
dose.en: A single room (negative pressure where available), N95 respirators for staff and a surgical mask for her when she leaves the room; lifted after three negative sputum smears or another diagnosis (CDC 2005).

name.zh-CN: 核实β-内酰胺类过敏标签并转诊过敏评估
name.en: Clarify the β-lactam allergy labels and refer for allergy assessment

dose.zh-CN: 逐一问清：哪种药、出现了什么反应（皮疹、风团、肿胀、呼吸困难、休克、皮肤剥脱）、发生在多少年前、怎么处理的、之后是否再用过同类药物；记录在病历中；转变态反应专科评估（皮试，必要时在监护下药物激发），决定能否去除标签（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。
dose.en: For each drug: what it was, what happened (rash, hives, swelling, breathing difficulty, collapse, skin peeling), how many years ago, how it was treated and whether she has taken the class since; document it; refer to an allergy service for testing and, where appropriate, a supervised challenge, to decide whether the labels can be removed (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022).

response.zh-CN: 已记录并转诊。本病例没有记录两种过敏反应的类型，也没有记录做过过敏评估；不模拟其结果，所以本病例中青霉素类和头孢菌素类仍不能使用。
response.en: Documented and referred. This case does not record the type of either reaction or any allergy assessment; it does not simulate a result, so penicillins and cephalosporins stay off limits in this case.

name.zh-CN: 评估血糖控制并调整降糖治疗
name.en: Review glucose control and adjust diabetes treatment

dose.zh-CN: 监测毛细血管血糖，查糖化血红蛋白，核对目前的降糖药；感染期间按需调整（必要时用胰岛素）。
dose.en: Capillary glucose monitoring, an HbA1c and a review of her current diabetes medicines; adjust during the infection (insulin if needed).

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录她的血糖、糖化血红蛋白或降糖治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record her glucose, HbA1c or diabetes treatment; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 与病理科讨论首次活检并加做特殊染色
name.en: Discuss the first biopsy with pathology and ask for special stains

dose.zh-CN: 请病理科描述菌团的形态并加做特殊染色；下次取材时另送组织做全面的微生物检查（需氧、厌氧和分枝杆菌培养）。
dose.en: Ask the pathologist to describe the colonies and to characterise them with special stains; at the next sampling, send tissue for full microbiology (aerobic, anaerobic and mycobacterial culture).

response.zh-CN: 已与病理科沟通。本病例没有记录首次标本加做了哪些染色、何时做的；不模拟其结果。
response.en: Discussed with pathology. This case does not record which stains were added to the first specimen, or when; it does not simulate their result.

dose.zh-CN: 多西环素 100 mg 口服，每日2次；疗程按诊断和治疗反应决定。
dose.en: Doxycycline 100 mg orally twice daily; duration set by the diagnosis and the response.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例记录的治疗用的是同属四环素类的米诺环素（剂量未记录）；不模拟多西环素的效果。
response.en: Started. The case records a different tetracycline, minocycline, in her treatment (dose not recorded); it does not simulate the effect of doxycycline.

dose.zh-CN: 米诺环素 100 mg 口服，每日2次。

harm.zh-CN: 她已经因为色素沉着和胃肠反应停用了米诺环素。米诺环素的色素沉着随累积剂量增加，停药后也可能不退；再用同一种药，不良反应可能加重，几个月的疗程也难以坚持——应换用另一类有效药物（Valour 2014：疗程以月计）。
harm.en: She has already stopped minocycline because of pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects. Minocycline pigmentation rises with the cumulative dose and may not fade after stopping; restarting the same drug risks worse adverse effects and a months-long course she cannot keep up — change to another active class instead (Valour 2014: treatment runs for months).

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例记录治疗中用过米诺环素（剂量和疗程未记录）；不模拟本次给药的效果。
response.en: Started. The case records minocycline in her treatment (dose and duration not recorded); it does not simulate the effect of this dose.

name.zh-CN: 口服大环内酯类（阿奇霉素或克拉霉素）

dose.zh-CN: 如克拉霉素 500 mg 口服，每日2次，或按当地方案用阿奇霉素；用药前先查心电图QTc，核对药物相互作用。
dose.en: For example clarithromycin 500 mg orally twice daily, or azithromycin by local protocol; check the QTc on an ECG and review interactions first.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例记录她后来的治疗用的是阿奇霉素（剂量和用法未记录）；不模拟本次给药的效果。
response.en: Started. The case records azithromycin later in her treatment (dose and schedule not recorded); it does not simulate the effect of this dose.

name.zh-CN: 安排疗程中和疗程结束时的CT复查
name.en: Plan CT reviews during and at the end of treatment

dose.zh-CN: 治疗中定期复查胸部CT，病灶吸收后再决定停药；停药后继续随访有无复发。
dose.en: Repeat chest CT during treatment and stop only once the lesion has resolved; keep following her for relapse after stopping.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。复查发现什么见记录的转归；本病例没有记录复查的间隔。
response.en: Planned. What the scans found is in the recorded outcome; this case does not record the scan intervals.

name.zh-CN: 莫西沙星（继续或再用一个疗程）

dose.zh-CN: 莫西沙星 400 mg，每日1次，口服或静脉。
dose.en: Moxifloxacin 400 mg once daily, orally or IV.

harm.zh-CN: 莫西沙星对结核分枝杆菌有活性，可使结核暂时好转、延误诊断并诱导耐药；ISTC（2014）建议在可能是结核时不要用氟喹诺酮类做试验性治疗。它也解决不了中央型肿块需要取组织的问题，而六年来每个短疗程之后都会复发。
harm.en: Moxifloxacin is active against M. tuberculosis: it can improve TB transiently, delay its diagnosis and select resistance, and ISTC (2014) advises against fluoroquinolones as an antibiotic trial when TB is possible. It also leaves the central mass unsampled, and for six years every short course has been followed by relapse.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例记录这次病程中用莫西沙星后病灶缩小；不模拟本次用药的效果。
response.en: Given. The case records that the lesion shrank on moxifloxacin earlier in this illness; it does not simulate the effect of this course.

name.zh-CN: 经验性四联抗结核治疗（HRZE）

dose.zh-CN: 异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺、乙胺丁醇按体重给药，强化期2个月。
dose.en: Isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol dosed by weight; a 2-month intensive phase.

harm.zh-CN: 没有任何分枝杆菌学证据就开始四联抗结核治疗，会让她承受数月的肝毒性等不良反应，影响此后标本的判读，而中央型肿块仍未取到组织。ISTC（2014）和WHO（2025）要求先留取标本（涂片、培养和快速分子检测），经验性治疗只用于标本送检后临床证据强烈提示结核的情况。
harm.en: Starting four drugs without any mycobacterial evidence exposes her to months of hepatotoxicity and other adverse effects, clouds the reading of later specimens and still leaves the central mass unsampled. ISTC (2014) and WHO (2025) ask for specimens first — smear, culture and a rapid molecular test — and keep empirical treatment for strong clinical evidence once specimens have been sent.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例没有记录这次病程用过抗结核治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started. The case records no TB treatment in this illness; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉青霉素G（之后口服阿莫西林）

dose.zh-CN: 大剂量青霉素G，分次静脉给药，适当时改口服阿莫西林；剂量和疗程按诊断决定。
dose.en: High-dose benzylpenicillin IV in divided doses, changing to oral amoxicillin when appropriate; dose and duration set by the diagnosis.

harm.zh-CN: 她有青霉素过敏标签，当时是什么反应、有多严重都不清楚：在问清病史、经变态反应专科评估之前给全剂量青霉素，可能引发危及生命的过敏反应，而现在完全可以选用不含β-内酰胺的有效药物（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022药物过敏实践参数）。
harm.en: She carries a penicillin allergy label whose reaction and severity are unknown: full-dose penicillin before the history is clarified and an allergy assessment is done risks a life-threatening reaction, when an effective drug without a β-lactam can be chosen instead (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 drug allergy practice parameter).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例的治疗中没有记录使用青霉素类；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The case records no penicillin in her treatment; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 头孢曲松 2 g 静脉滴注，每日1次。

harm.zh-CN: 她还有头孢类过敏标签，反应类型同样不明：这不是从青霉素换到交叉反应很低的头孢，而是直接使用她自己报告过敏的一类药物；和青霉素一样，应等过敏评估之后再说（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。
harm.en: She also carries a cephalosporin allergy label of equally unknown type: this is not a low-risk switch away from penicillin but exposure to a class she reports reacting to, and like penicillin it should wait for allergy assessment (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例的治疗中没有记录使用头孢菌素类；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The case records no cephalosporin in her treatment; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 甲硝唑 500 mg 口服，每日3次。
dose.en: Metronidazole 500 mg orally three times a day.

harm.zh-CN: 甲硝唑对放线菌没有可靠的活性：避开了过敏标签，用的却是一个无效的药。首选药是青霉素（Valour 2014），不能用青霉素时改用四环素类或大环内酯类。
harm.en: Metronidazole has no reliable activity against Actinomyces: it avoids the allergy labels with a drug that does not work. The drug of choice is penicillin (Valour 2014); when penicillin cannot be used, a tetracycline or a macrolide is chosen instead.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用甲硝唑；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. The case records no metronidazole; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 胸外科会诊，评估切除病灶。
dose.en: Thoracic surgical referral to assess resection of the lesion.

harm.zh-CN: 现在不需要手术：诊断还没明确时，应先再次取材、鉴定所见的病原（ACCP 2013）；若是可以用药物治愈的感染，手术只用于严重病例或并发症，或药物治疗失败时（Boot 2023；Valour 2014）。
harm.en: Surgery is not the next step: without a diagnosis the airway can be sampled again and any organism seen identified first (ACCP 2013); and if this is an infection that medicines can cure, surgery is kept for severe disease or complications, or for failed drug treatment (Boot 2023; Valour 2014).

response.zh-CN: 已请胸外科会诊。本病例记录的这次病程中没有手术；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Thoracic surgery asked to see her. The case records no operation in this illness; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清六年的病程，查体并调阅CT
title.en: Take the six-year story, examine her and read the CT

hint.zh-CN: 同一部位反复六年、每次用抗生素都会好转，可能是什么？这次的发热、既往手术和过敏史各给你什么提示？
hint.en: What could keep returning in the same place for six years and settle with every course of antibiotics — and what do this fever, the old operation and her allergies each add?

guidance.zh-CN: 在床旁问诊：病程、这次加重、以前和这次的用药、肺部手术、慢性病和过敏；测体温和血压、听诊双肺；到病历终端或床旁病历调阅胸部CT报告。
guidance.en: At the bedside: the course, this flare, the antibiotics before and this time, the lung operation, long-term illnesses and allergies; take her temperature and blood pressure and listen to her chest; read the chest CT reports at a records terminal or in the notes at the bedside.

title.en: Choose the first tests and send them

hint.zh-CN: 抗菌治疗后缩小，能排除哪些病、排除不了哪些病？一个中央型肿块，用什么方式取到组织最合适？
hint.en: Which causes does shrinkage on antibiotics rule out, and which does it not? How would you best get tissue from a central mass?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病例讨论板回答决策1，然后开出你选择的检查和防护措施。
guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board, then order the tests and precautions you chose.

hint.zh-CN: 一次活检没找到肿瘤细胞，能说明什么、不能说明什么？坏死组织里的细菌菌团，你还想知道它的什么？
hint.en: What does one biopsy without tumour cells show — and not show? What else would you want to know about bacteria in necrotic tissue?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅痰检结果、支气管镜报告和活检病理，然后回答决策2。
guidance.en: Read the sputum results, the bronchoscopy report and the biopsy pathology, then answer decision 2.

title.zh-CN: 查明复发的原因并开始治疗
title.en: Find the cause of the relapse and start treatment

hint.zh-CN: 这几种染色各能识别什么？哪些病原会形成颗粒？她报告的两类过敏会怎样改变你通常的首选药物？
hint.en: What does each of these stains pick out, and which organisms form granules? How do her two allergy labels change the drug you would usually choose?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅复查的CT、支气管镜报告和标本病理，回答决策3和4，并开始你选择的治疗。
guidance.en: Read the repeat CT, the bronchoscopy report and the specimen pathology, answer decisions 3 and 4, and start the treatment you chose.

hint.zh-CN: 停用这个药以后，感染还需要治多久？换成哪一类药？换药之前要查什么？
hint.en: Once this drug is stopped, how much longer does the infection need treating, with which class instead — and what do you check before switching?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她用药的情况，回答决策5，并开始你选择的药物。
guidance.en: Ask her how the treatment went, answer decision 5 and start the drug you chose.

title.zh-CN: 对照记录的疗程与转归
title.en: Compare your plan with the recorded course

hint.zh-CN: 记录的治疗和你的计划哪里一致、哪里不同？停药以后还应随访什么？
hint.en: Where did the recorded treatment match your plan, and where not? What would you still follow up once treatment ends?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅记录的疗程与转归。
guidance.en: Read the recorded treatment course and outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 55岁女性，六年来每年一两次咳嗽、痰中带血，每次用约两周抗生素后好转；这次20天前加重，发热最高39℃。入院体温38℃，右肺可闻及局限性干啰音。8年前右肺中叶切除，病理称肺结核，术后抗结核治疗3个月。胸部CT：右肺门约4.5 cm肿块，抗菌治疗（这次是莫西沙星）后缩小。下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: A 55-year-old woman has had blood-streaked sputum once or twice a year for six years, settling each time on about two weeks of antibiotics; 20 days ago it flared with fever up to 39 °C. On admission her temperature is 38 °C, with localised rhonchi over the right lung. Eight years ago a right middle lobectomy was reported as tuberculosis and followed by three months of TB treatment. The chest CT shows a right hilar mass of about 4.5 cm that became smaller after antibiotics (moxifloxacin this time). What is your next step?

need.zh-CN: 先问清六年的病程、以往和这次的抗菌治疗、这次加重的情况和既往手术，测体温、听诊双肺，并调阅胸部CT报告。
need.en: First take the six-year course, the antibiotics before and this time, this flare and the earlier operation; take her temperature, listen to her chest and read the chest CT reports.

text.zh-CN: 不把缩小当作治愈：送3份痰做抗酸涂片、分枝杆菌培养和结核快速分子检测，再做支气管镜活检加灌洗；排除结核之前按空气传播隔离。
text.en: Do not read the shrinkage as cure: three sputum samples for acid-fast smear, mycobacterial culture and a rapid molecular TB test, then bronchoscopy with biopsy and lavage, under airborne precautions meanwhile.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。抗菌后缩小并不能排除肿瘤——阻塞后方的感染也会随抗菌治疗好转——而莫西沙星对结核分枝杆菌也有活性，可能掩盖结核。ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017指南推荐痰抗酸涂片和分枝杆菌培养（以3份标本为常规），并建议对首份标本做核酸扩增检测，WHO 2025推荐以快速分子检测作为初始检查；中央型病灶首选支气管镜取材（ACCP 2013：对中央型支气管内肺癌的汇总敏感度88%）。排除结核之前，她应当处于空气传播隔离之下。
feedback.en: Right. Shrinkage on antibiotics does not exclude a tumour — the infection behind an obstruction also settles — and moxifloxacin is active against M. tuberculosis, so it can mask TB. ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 recommends sputum acid-fast smear and mycobacterial culture — three specimens is the norm — and suggests a nucleic acid amplification test on the first, and WHO 2025 recommends a rapid molecular test as the initial test; a central lesion is sampled by bronchoscopy (ACCP 2013: pooled sensitivity 88 % for central endobronchial cancer). Until TB is excluded she stays under airborne precautions.

text.zh-CN: 按逐渐吸收的细菌性肺炎处理：把这个莫西沙星疗程用完，6周后复查胸部CT；到那时肿块还没有消失，再安排支气管镜检查也不迟。
text.en: Treat it as a resolving bacterial pneumonia: complete this course of moxifloxacin and repeat the chest CT in six weeks, arranging a bronchoscopy only if the mass has not gone by then.

feedback.zh-CN: 这正是过去六年的循环：每个疗程都让情况好转，停药后又复发。莫西沙星后缩小，既排除不了阻塞后方的肿瘤，也排除不了结核——ISTC（2014）正因为氟喹诺酮类能让结核暂时好转，建议在可能是结核时不要用它做试验性治疗。55岁、中央型肿块，现在就需要组织学证据，而不是再等一个疗程。
feedback.en: This is the cycle of the last six years: every course has improved the picture and the disease has come back. Shrinkage on moxifloxacin excludes neither a tumour behind the infection nor TB — ISTC (2014) advises against fluoroquinolones as a trial when TB is possible precisely because they can improve it transiently. A central mass at 55 needs tissue now, not after another course.

text.zh-CN: 按结核复发处理：手术后只治了3个月，疗程明显不足，现在就重新开始异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺和乙胺丁醇四联治疗，2个月后复查胸部CT。
text.en: Treat it as relapsed tuberculosis: three months of treatment after the lobectomy was far too short and diabetes adds to the risk, so restart isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol now and repeat the chest CT in two months.

feedback.zh-CN: 旧的“结核”诊断只有一句病史，这次病程还没有任何分枝杆菌学证据。ISTC（2014）和WHO（2025）都要求先留取标本——涂片、培养和快速分子检测——再决定治疗；先上四联药物会让她承受数月的肝毒性等不良反应，影响之后标本的判读，而中央型肿块仍然没有取到组织。
feedback.en: The old TB label rests on one line of history, and nothing in this illness yet shows mycobacteria. ISTC (2014) and WHO (2025) ask for specimens — smear, culture and a rapid molecular test — before treatment; starting four drugs first exposes her to months of hepatotoxicity and other adverse effects, clouds the reading of later specimens and still leaves the central mass unsampled.

text.zh-CN: 取组织最快的办法是CT引导下经皮穿刺肺门肿块，取到的组织比支气管镜多；痰检可以等病理确定是不是肿瘤以后再说。
text.en: The quickest tissue is a CT-guided percutaneous core biopsy of the hilar mass, which gives more tissue than bronchoscopy; the sputum tests can wait until the histology shows whether it is a tumour.

feedback.zh-CN: 中央型、肺门部病灶首选支气管镜：既能直接看到气道，又能取活检和灌洗做微生物检查（ACCP 2013）；经皮穿刺肺门肿块靠近大血管，出血和气胸的风险更高。而且结核检查不能等病理：痰标本应当马上送检（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017）。
feedback.en: A central, hilar lesion is sampled by bronchoscopy first, which shows the airway and allows biopsy and lavage for microbiology (ACCP 2013); a percutaneous needle into a hilar mass lies close to the great vessels, with more risk of bleeding and pneumothorax. And TB testing should not wait for histology: the sputum goes now (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017).

text.zh-CN: 先做PET-CT：摄取高就按肿瘤处理，直接请外科评估手术；摄取低就说明是感染，现在用的抗生素正好在治。
text.en: Order a PET-CT first: high uptake would mean a tumour and a surgical referral, while low uptake would show an infection that the current antibiotics are already treating.

feedback.zh-CN: 感染和炎症与许多肿瘤一样摄取FDG，PET-CT分不清这里是感染还是肿瘤，只会拖延时间，仍然没有组织和病原学证据。ACCP 2013要求以组织学确立肺癌诊断——中央型病灶经支气管镜取材——结核检查也应当立即开始。
feedback.en: Infection and inflammation take up FDG as avidly as many tumours, so a PET-CT cannot settle infection against tumour here; it costs time and still leaves her without tissue or microbiology. ACCP 2013 bases the diagnosis of suspected lung cancer on tissue — by bronchoscopy for a central lesion — and TB testing should start at once.

prompt.zh-CN: 结果回报：多次痰抗酸涂片和痰培养均阴性，同时所送的其他感染相关检查也阴性。支气管镜：支气管黏膜充血、水肿，管腔狭窄。活检：炎性肉芽组织和坏死，可见细菌菌团，未见肿瘤细胞。你怎么判断，下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: The results are back. Repeated sputum acid-fast smears and cultures are negative, as are the other infection tests sent with them. Bronchoscopy: hyperaemic, oedematous bronchial mucosa with narrowing of the lumen. Biopsy: inflammatory granulation tissue and necrosis with bacterial colonies; no tumour cells. What do you conclude, and what next?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅痰检结果、支气管镜报告和活检病理。
need.en: First read the sputum results, the bronchoscopy report and the biopsy pathology.

text.zh-CN: 还不能下结论：一次活检未见肿瘤细胞排除不了肿瘤，菌团也要鉴定——请病理科加做革兰、银染和弱抗酸染色，CT随访，肿块不消或复发就尽早复查支气管镜。
text.en: No diagnosis yet: one biopsy without tumour cells does not exclude a tumour, and the colonies need naming — ask pathology for Gram, silver and modified acid-fast stains; CT follow-up, re-scoping early if the mass persists or returns.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。支气管镜未能确诊并不能排除恶性肿瘤，ACCP 2013要求在怀疑仍在时继续取材。坏死肉芽组织中的细菌菌团需要鉴定而不是忽略：革兰、银染、抗酸和弱抗酸染色能把细菌、真菌和分枝杆菌区分开，常能认出培养难以长出的病原（Könönen and Wade 2015）。六年来用药就好、停药就犯，这个规律本身就提示有一个被抑制却没有被清除的病因。
feedback.en: Right. A non-diagnostic bronchoscopy does not exclude malignancy, and ACCP 2013 asks for further sampling while suspicion remains. Bacterial colonies in necrotic granulation tissue need a name, not dismissal: Gram, silver, acid-fast and modified acid-fast stains tell bacteria, fungi and mycobacteria apart and can recognise organisms that are hard to culture (Könönen and Wade 2015). Six years of settling on treatment and returning off it point to a cause that is suppressed but not removed.

text.zh-CN: 这是正在吸收的细菌性肺炎：没有肿瘤细胞、痰检阴性、肿块也在缩小，问题已经清楚——用完抗生素就出院，没有症状就不用再复查影像。
text.en: A resolving bacterial pneumonia: no tumour cells, repeatedly negative sputum and a shrinking mass settle the question, so finish the antibiotics, discharge her home and arrange no further chest imaging unless her symptoms ever return.

feedback.zh-CN: 以前每一次也都“好了”，后来又复发。一次活检没见肿瘤细胞、痰检阴性，只是降低了肿瘤和结核的可能，并不能排除，菌团也还没有解释；现在结案，等于准备迎接第七年的复发。ACCP 2013要求在怀疑仍在时继续取材。
feedback.en: Every earlier bout also ‘resolved’ — and came back. One biopsy without tumour cells and negative sputum lower the chance of a tumour or TB but exclude neither, and the colonies are unexplained; closing the case now invites a seventh year of relapses. ACCP 2013 asks for further sampling while suspicion remains.

text.zh-CN: 最符合涂片阴性的肺结核：有坏死，以前诊断过结核而且只治了3个月，结核本来就常常涂片阴性——尽管培养阴性，也应该现在就开始规范的四联抗结核治疗，不必再等。
text.en: Smear-negative tuberculosis fits best: necrosis in someone with an earlier TB diagnosis treated for only three months, and smears are often negative in TB — start four-drug TB treatment now despite the negative cultures.

feedback.zh-CN: 这里没有指向结核的证据：多次涂片和培养都是阴性，活检见到的是细菌菌团，结核解释不了。ISTC（2014）只在留取标本之后、临床证据强烈提示结核时才考虑经验性治疗；现在上四联药物只会增加毒性，菌团仍然没有解释。
feedback.en: Nothing here points to tuberculosis: repeated smears and cultures are negative, and the biopsy shows bacterial colonies that TB does not explain. ISTC (2014) keeps empirical treatment for strong clinical evidence after specimens have been sent; four drugs now add toxicity and leave the colonies unexplained.

text.zh-CN: 按活检漏掉的肿瘤处理：55岁、肺门肿块伴支气管狭窄，应该手术，现在就转外科切除，不必再做一次支气管镜。
text.en: Assume a tumour the biopsy missed: a hilar mass with bronchial narrowing at 55 needs surgery, so refer her for resection now rather than sample the airway a second time.

feedback.zh-CN: 没有诊断就手术为时过早：可以先复查支气管镜、鉴定菌团、尝试其他取材途径（ACCP 2013）。如果最后证实是感染，切除就是为一个可能用药物治愈的病做一台大手术；手术应留给并发症或治疗失败的情况。
feedback.en: Surgery without a diagnosis is premature: the airway can be sampled again, the colonies identified and other routes tried first (ACCP 2013). If this proves to be an infection, resection would be a major operation for a condition that medicines may cure; surgery is kept for complications or treatment failure.

text.zh-CN: 菌团是支气管镜带进去的口腔细菌，没有意义：坏死和狭窄只是感染后的改变，停用抗生素，3个月后复查CT就可以了。
text.en: The colonies are mouth bacteria carried in by the bronchoscope and mean nothing: the necrosis and narrowing are post-infective, so stop the antibiotics and repeat the CT in three months.

feedback.zh-CN: 口腔细菌确实会污染支气管镜标本，但长在狭窄支气管坏死肉芽组织里的菌团，在被证明是污染之前应当视为病变的一部分；把口腔常见菌误当作污染、忽视其致病作用，是公认的陷阱（Könönen and Wade 2015）。忽略它并停药，只会重复以往的循环。
feedback.en: Mouth bacteria do contaminate bronchoscopic samples, but colonies within necrotic granulation tissue from a narrowed bronchus are part of the lesion until shown otherwise; dismissing oral organisms as contaminants is a recognised pitfall (Könönen and Wade 2015). Ignoring them and stopping treatment repeats the old cycle.

prompt.zh-CN: 停用抗菌药后，复查CT见肿块再次出现，伴渗出影。复查支气管镜：黄色颗粒堵塞支气管。标本病理：硫磺颗粒，周围可见放射状排列的菌丝；革兰染色阳性，银染色阳性；抗酸染色和弱抗酸染色均阴性。最可能的诊断是什么？
prompt.en: After the antibiotics were stopped, the CT shows the mass back, with infiltrates. Repeat bronchoscopy: yellow granules blocking the bronchus. Pathology of the specimens: sulphur granules with radiating filaments around them; Gram stain positive, silver stain positive; acid-fast and modified acid-fast stains both negative. What is the most likely diagnosis?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅复查的CT、支气管镜报告和标本病理。
need.en: First read the repeat CT, the bronchoscopy report and the pathology of its specimens.

text.zh-CN: 肺放线菌病：革兰阳性的丝状细菌形成硫磺颗粒，两种抗酸染色均为阴性
text.en: Pulmonary actinomycosis: Gram-positive filamentous bacteria forming sulphur granules, negative on both acid-fast stains

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。硫磺颗粒周围放射状的菌丝，革兰和银染阳性，而抗酸和弱抗酸染色都阴性，这是放线菌的特征（Boot 2023：抗酸阴性的放射状菌和硫磺颗粒是它与其他疾病的区别要点）；先前坏死组织中的菌团、每次用药好转而停药复发的病程也与之相符（Valour 2014）。专科复核确认了这一诊断。
feedback.en: Right. Sulphur granules ringed by radiating filaments that are Gram- and silver-positive but negative on both the acid-fast and the modified acid-fast stain are the signature of Actinomyces (Boot 2023: acid-fast-negative, ray-like organisms and sulphur granules set it apart); the earlier colonies in necrotic tissue and the course of response and relapse fit (Valour 2014). Specialist review of the specimens confirms it.

text.zh-CN: 肺诺卡菌病：银染阳性的革兰阳性丝状菌，发生在有糖尿病、反复用过抗生素的患者身上
text.en: Pulmonary nocardiosis: silver-positive, Gram-positive filaments in a patient with diabetes, repeated antibiotic courses and an old lung operation

feedback.zh-CN: 诺卡菌同样是革兰阳性、银染阳性的丝状菌，所以是最接近的鉴别——但它是弱抗酸性的，弱抗酸染色通常阳性，而这里是阴性；硫磺颗粒也是放线菌而非肺诺卡菌病的典型表现（Boot 2023：抗酸阴性的菌和硫磺颗粒是放线菌病的鉴别要点）。两者的治疗不同：诺卡菌用复方磺胺甲噁唑，而不是青霉素。
feedback.en: Nocardia is also a Gram-positive, silver-staining filament, which makes this the closest alternative — but it is weakly acid-fast and usually positive on the modified acid-fast stain, which here is negative, and sulphur granules are typical of Actinomyces rather than of pulmonary Nocardia (Boot 2023: acid-fast-negative organisms and sulphur granules mark out actinomycosis). The difference matters: Nocardia is treated with co-trimoxazole, not penicillin.

text.zh-CN: 气道曲霉病：多次用过抗生素的糖尿病患者，银染阳性的菌丝堵塞狭窄的支气管
text.en: Airway aspergillosis: silver-positive hyphae plugging a narrowed bronchus in a patient with diabetes after many antibiotic courses

feedback.zh-CN: 银染也能染真菌，但曲霉的菌丝更粗、有分隔，属于真菌，不形成硫磺颗粒，也不是革兰阳性细菌；这里革兰阳性的放射状菌丝是细菌（Boot 2023：硫磺颗粒和抗酸阴性的放射状菌是鉴别要点）。诊断错了，治疗方向——抗真菌还是抗细菌——也就错了。
feedback.en: Silver stains fungi too, but Aspergillus hyphae are broader, septate fungal filaments that do not form sulphur granules and are not Gram-positive bacteria; the Gram-positive radiating filaments here are bacterial (Boot 2023: sulphur granules and acid-fast-negative, ray-like organisms are the distinguishing features). Get this wrong and the treatment — antifungal instead of antibacterial — is wrong too.

text.zh-CN: 肺叶切除后那次结核复发：干酪样物质堵塞支气管，染色时漏检了抗酸杆菌
text.en: Relapse of the tuberculosis treated after the lobectomy: caseous material blocking the bronchus, with the bacilli missed on staining

feedback.zh-CN: 结核应能见到抗酸杆菌，典型者有干酪样坏死性肉芽肿；这里两种抗酸染色都阴性，多次痰涂片和培养也是阴性，放射状菌丝形成的颗粒更不是结核的表现。至于8年前的“结核”诊断是否可靠，倒值得请病理科复核当年的切片（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017以培养作为诊断的参考标准）。
feedback.en: Tuberculosis would show acid-fast bacilli and, typically, caseating granulomas; both acid-fast stains are negative here, as were repeated sputum smears and cultures, and granules of radiating filaments are not a feature of TB. Whether the TB label of eight years ago was right is a fair question to put to the pathologist (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 treats culture as the reference standard).

text.zh-CN: 葡萄状菌病：葡萄球菌等非丝状细菌在慢性感染的气道组织中形成细菌颗粒
text.en: Botryomycosis: bacterial granules formed by staphylococci or other non-filamentous bacteria in chronically infected airway tissue

feedback.zh-CN: 葡萄状菌病确实会形成颗粒，但颗粒由葡萄球菌等非丝状细菌组成，革兰染色看到的是球菌或杆菌；这里的放射状菌丝提示放线菌，而不是葡萄状菌病（Boot 2023）。
feedback.en: Botryomycosis does produce granules, but they are made of non-filamentous bacteria such as staphylococci, seen as cocci or rods on Gram stain; the radiating filaments here point to an actinomycete instead (Boot 2023).

prompt.zh-CN: 诊断为肺放线菌病。她说自己对青霉素和头孢类都过敏，但当时是什么反应，她说不上来，病历里也没有写。你怎么开始治疗？
prompt.en: The diagnosis is pulmonary actinomycosis. She reports allergies to penicillin and to cephalosporins but cannot say what the reactions were, and her notes do not say either. How do you start treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先回答决策3，并问清她的过敏史。
need.en: First answer decision 3 and ask about her allergies.

text.zh-CN: 记录过敏标签并转诊过敏评估——青霉素是首选，标签若被排除就能用；在此之前口服多西环素100 mg、每日2次（或米诺环素），疗程以月计，按CT调整。
text.en: Record the labels and refer her for allergy assessment, as penicillin is the drug of choice if they prove false; meanwhile oral doxycycline 100 mg twice daily (or minocycline) for months, guided by CT.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。青霉素是放线菌病的首选药物，传统上大剂量使用6–12个月（Valour 2014），一个未经核实的过敏标签会让她在长疗程中失去最好的药；AAAAI/ACAAI 2022支持结构化评估和检测，以去除不属实的标签。在此之前，四环素类是常用的替代药物——多西环素100 mg、每日2次（原报告用的是米诺环素）——疗程按临床和CT反应决定（Boot 2023：长疗程抗菌治疗是治疗的主体）。
feedback.en: Right. Penicillin is the drug of choice for actinomycosis, traditionally at high dose for 6–12 months (Valour 2014), so an unverified label costs her the best drug for a long course; AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 supports structured assessment and testing to remove labels that are wrong. Meanwhile a tetracycline is the usual alternative — doxycycline 100 mg twice daily (the report used minocycline) — with the duration set by clinical and CT response (Boot 2023: prolonged antibiotic therapy is the mainstay).

text.zh-CN: 现在就静脉用青霉素G、每日1800万–2400万U：它是首选药，而且大多数青霉素过敏标签最后都证明不属实；2–6周后改口服阿莫西林，总疗程6–12个月。
text.en: Start IV benzylpenicillin 18–24 million units a day now: it is the drug of choice and most penicillin labels turn out to be false; switch to oral amoxicillin after 2–6 weeks and continue for 6–12 months in all.

feedback.zh-CN: 大多数青霉素过敏标签确实不属实，但她当时是什么反应、是否曾是严重过敏反应或严重皮肤反应，现在没人知道；AAAAI/ACAAI 2022要求先问清病史、必要时由变态反应专科检测，再决定能否用青霉素。在有安全替代药的情况下盲目给全剂量静脉青霉素，可能引发危及生命的反应。
feedback.en: Most penicillin labels are indeed wrong, but nobody knows what her reactions were — anaphylaxis or a severe skin reaction among the possibilities — and AAAAI/ACAAI 2022 asks for that history and, where needed, allergist testing before a penicillin is given. Full-dose IV penicillin given blind, when a safe alternative exists, risks a life-threatening reaction.

text.zh-CN: 改用头孢曲松2 g静脉、每日1次：青霉素与三代头孢菌素之间的交叉过敏很少，青霉素过敏标签不妨碍使用，疗程同样以月计。
text.en: Use IV ceftriaxone 2 g once daily instead: cross-reactivity between penicillins and third-generation cephalosporins is low, so the penicillin label does not stop it, for a course of months.

feedback.zh-CN: 她同时有头孢类过敏标签，类型同样不明：这不是从青霉素换到交叉反应很低的头孢，而是直接使用她自己报告过敏的一类药物。和青霉素一样，应等过敏评估之后再说（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。
feedback.en: She carries a cephalosporin label too, of equally unknown type, so this is not a low-risk switch away from penicillin but exposure to a class she reports reacting to. Like penicillin, it should wait for allergy assessment (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022).

text.zh-CN: 口服甲硝唑500 mg、每日3次，用6个月：放线菌是厌氧菌，甲硝唑能避开她的两种过敏标签，在坏死组织中也能作用于厌氧菌。
text.en: Start oral metronidazole 500 mg three times a day for six months: Actinomyces is an anaerobe, and metronidazole avoids both of her allergy labels while reaching anaerobes in necrotic tissue.

feedback.zh-CN: 放线菌是厌氧或微需氧菌，但甲硝唑对它没有可靠的活性，这个方案会失败。首选药是青霉素（Valour 2014），不能用青霉素时改用四环素类或大环内酯类；避开了过敏标签，用的却是一个无效的药。
feedback.en: Actinomyces is anaerobic or microaerophilic, but metronidazole has no reliable activity against it, so this regimen would fail. The drug of choice is penicillin (Valour 2014), with a tetracycline or a macrolide when penicillin cannot be used; this avoids the allergy labels with a drug that does not work.

text.zh-CN: 再用两周莫西沙星：她能耐受，以前也让肿块缩小过；等发热消退、复查CT好转就停药。
text.en: Give another two-week course of moxifloxacin, which she tolerated and which shrank the mass before, and stop once the fever has gone and the CT has improved.

feedback.zh-CN: 六年来两周一个疗程的结果已经很清楚：感染被压下去，然后复发。放线菌病需要以月计的疗程（Valour 2014：传统上6–12个月），氟喹诺酮类对放线菌的活性也不可靠。
feedback.en: Six years of two-week courses have shown what happens: the infection settles and returns. Actinomycosis needs months of treatment (Valour 2014: traditionally 6–12 months), and fluoroquinolone activity against Actinomyces is unreliable.

prompt.zh-CN: 按记录的病程，治疗用的是米诺环素，因色素沉着和胃肠反应已经停用。接下来她的抗菌治疗怎么安排？
prompt.en: In the recorded course the treatment was minocycline, and it has been stopped because of pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects. How do you continue her antibiotic treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先回答决策4，并问问她用米诺环素的情况。
need.en: First answer decision 4 and ask her how the minocycline went.

text.zh-CN: 改用口服大环内酯类（原报告用阿奇霉素，也可用克拉霉素），先查QTc、核对相互作用；以月计继续治疗到CT显示吸收，并继续推进过敏评估。
text.en: Switch to an oral macrolide (azithromycin, as in the report, or clarithromycin) after a QTc and interaction check, treat on for months until the CT shows resolution, and keep the allergy assessment going.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。米诺环素的色素沉着与累积剂量有关，停药后也可能不退，是停药的理由；但感染仍需要数月的治疗。不能用青霉素和四环素类时，大环内酯类是公认的替代药物，不过阿奇霉素的临床资料有限；长疗程前查QTc并核对相互作用，继续推进过敏评估，以便标签排除后改用青霉素；何时停药按症状和CT决定，传统疗程为6–12个月（Valour 2014）。
feedback.en: Right. Minocycline pigmentation rises with the cumulative dose and may not fade, which is a reason to stop it — but the infection still needs months of treatment. A macrolide is a recognised alternative when penicillin and tetracyclines cannot be used, although the clinical data for azithromycin are limited; check the QTc and interactions before a long course, keep the allergy assessment going so that penicillin can follow if the labels fall, and judge the end by symptoms and CT, over a course that traditionally runs 6–12 months (Valour 2014).

text.zh-CN: 等胃肠症状缓解后，按原剂量重新开始米诺环素：色素沉着只影响外观，疗程结束后自然会消退，而中途换药反而容易让病情再次复发，实在得不偿失。
text.en: Restart the minocycline at the same dose once her stomach has settled: the pigmentation is only cosmetic and fades after the course ends, and changing drugs halfway through the treatment risks yet another relapse.

feedback.zh-CN: 米诺环素的色素沉着并不只是暂时的外观问题：它随累积剂量增加，停药后也可能长期不退；胃肠反应还会让她难以坚持数月的疗程。疗程需要以月计（Valour 2014），所以应换用另一类有效药物，而不是让她再忍受同一种药。
feedback.en: Minocycline pigmentation is not just a passing cosmetic matter: it rises with the cumulative dose and may persist after stopping, and the gastrointestinal effects make a months-long course hard to keep up. Treatment runs for months (Valour 2014), so another active class is needed, not more of the same drug.

text.zh-CN: 既然已经用过一段时间的药，就把抗生素全部停掉，3个月后复查胸部CT，有症状再重新开始治疗。
text.en: Stop antibiotics altogether now that she has had a period of treatment, repeat the chest CT in three months and restart only if symptoms come back.

feedback.zh-CN: 过早停药正是过去六年反复复发的那种模式：放线菌病需要以月计的疗程，并以临床和CT吸收作为停药依据（Valour 2014；Boot 2023）。
feedback.en: Stopping early is the pattern that has gone with six years of relapses: actinomycosis needs months of treatment, ended on clinical and CT resolution (Valour 2014; Boot 2023).

text.zh-CN: 她不能耐受药物，就改为手术切除病灶，围手术期再用一个短疗程的抗生素。
text.en: Refer her for surgical resection instead, since she cannot tolerate the drugs, with a short course of antibiotics around the operation.

feedback.zh-CN: 不能耐受一种药不是手术指征——还有其他有效的药物可以换用。放线菌病以长疗程抗菌治疗为主，手术只用于严重病例或并发症（Boot 2023）；切除病灶也免不了术后的抗菌治疗（Valour 2014）。
feedback.en: Intolerance of one drug is not an indication for surgery when other active drugs remain. Prolonged antibiotics are the mainstay of actinomycosis and surgery is reserved for severe cases (Boot 2023); resection would not spare her the antibiotics afterwards either (Valour 2014).

text.zh-CN: 问清病程：六年来痰中带血及其频率、以往抗生素后好转、这次发热加重、这次莫西沙星后的变化和气短
text.en: Took the course: six years of blood-streaked sputum and how often, settling on earlier antibiotics, this febrile flare, the response to moxifloxacin this time and the breathlessness

text.zh-CN: 问了既往肺叶切除及其“结核”诊断、糖尿病、结核接触史、两类过敏标签以及过敏反应的细节
text.en: Asked about the lobectomy and its TB label, diabetes, TB contacts, both allergy labels and what the reactions were

text.zh-CN: 测了体温和血压，并听诊双肺
text.en: Took her temperature and blood pressure and listened to both lungs

text.zh-CN: 再次治疗前先取证：入院阶段送痰抗酸涂片和培养、结核快速分子检测，并安排支气管镜
text.en: Sampled before treating again: in the admission phase, sputum for acid-fast smear and culture and a rapid molecular TB test, and a bronchoscopy arranged

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答即选对首轮检查方案，并在排除结核前采取空气传播隔离
text.en: Chose the first work-up correctly at the first attempt and kept her under airborne precautions until TB was excluded

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答即正确解读首轮结果，并请病理科对菌团加做特殊染色
text.en: Read the first results correctly at the first attempt and asked pathology to stain the colonies

text.zh-CN: 调阅复发后的CT、支气管镜和标本病理，并第一次作答即作出正确诊断
text.en: Read the relapse CT, the repeat bronchoscopy and the specimen pathology, and made the diagnosis at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答即选对起始方案：核实过敏标签并转诊评估，开始一种非β-内酰胺类的有效药物
text.en: Chose the starting plan at the first attempt: the allergy labels clarified and referred for assessment, and an active non-β-lactam started

text.zh-CN: 第一次作答即正确处理不耐受：换用大环内酯类把疗程用足，并安排CT复查
text.en: Handled the intolerance correctly at the first attempt: changed to a macrolide to complete the course and planned CT reviews

text.zh-CN: 过敏标签评估之前，没有给任何青霉素类或头孢菌素类药物
text.en: Gave no penicillin or cephalosporin before her allergy labels had been assessed

text.zh-CN: 没有采取会掩盖结核或无效的措施：未再用莫西沙星、未经验性抗结核、未用甲硝唑、停药后未再用米诺环素、未贸然转外科手术
text.en: Avoided steps that mask TB or do not work: no further moxifloxacin, no empirical TB treatment, no metronidazole, no minocycline after it was stopped and no premature surgery

text.zh-CN: 向她解释为什么病情反复、需要哪些检查、为什么要用几个月的药以及过敏标签的问题，并确认她听懂了
text.en: Explained to her why the illness kept returning, which tests were needed, why treatment takes months and what the allergy labels mean, and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评价。入院时：先了解她最担心的事（怕肺里长了不好的东西），解释为什么不能再只用一个疗程的抗生素，为什么要留痰查结核、暂时隔离和做支气管镜（目的、过程、风险，取得知情同意），不过早保证“不是癌”或断言“就是结核”。确诊后：用通俗的话说明这是一种细菌引起的慢性感染，不是肿瘤，也不是结核；为什么要用几个月的药、为什么以前的短疗程会反复、为什么要按时复查CT；为什么过敏标签需要评估，以及她可以回忆或找来的过敏细节；需要报告的不良反应（皮肤颜色改变、胃肠不适；改用大环内酯类后出现心慌要说）；用回授法确认理解。不责怪以往的短疗程治疗；坦白随访多久、会不会复发等仍不确定的地方。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge by Calgary–Cambridge. On admission: find out what worries her most (that something bad is growing in her lung); explain why another short course of antibiotics is not enough and why sputum for TB, temporary isolation and a bronchoscopy are needed (purpose, procedure, risks, consent); give no premature reassurance that it is not cancer and no premature verdict that it is TB. After the diagnosis: explain in plain words that this is a chronic bacterial infection — not cancer and not TB; why treatment lasts months, why the short courses kept failing and why CT follow-up matters; why the allergy labels need assessing and which details she could recall or find; which adverse effects to report (a change in skin colour, stomach upset; palpitations on a macrolide); and check understanding by teach-back. No blame for the earlier short courses; be open about what remains uncertain, such as how long follow-up should last and the chance of relapse.

name.zh-CN: 傅医生（呼吸科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教的呼吸科主治医师，只围绕学员已经掌握的信息提问，不给结果，不说出诊断。决策1之前：“同一部位六年来反复发作、每次用抗生素都会好转，可能是什么？”——引导出阻塞性病变（包括生长缓慢的中央型肿瘤）伴感染、结核、慢性细菌感染、异物或支气管结石、支气管扩张；“用莫西沙星后缩小，能排除什么、不能排除什么？”（莫西沙星对结核有活性，阻塞后方的感染也会好转）；“中央型肺门肿块怎么取材？”；“术后只治了3个月的‘结核’，到底说明了什么？”。决策2之后：“一次活检阴性能排除什么？”“坏死组织里的菌团为什么值得追问？”。只有在决策3之后才问：“哪种染色能把这个病原和诺卡菌分开？”；决策4之前：“首选药是什么？今天是什么让你不能用？”“关于过敏反应，你需要知道哪些细节？”。历史与现行做法的对照（只在学员进入治疗阶段之后讨论）：记录的治疗是米诺环素，后改阿奇霉素；现在会同时推进过敏评估，若标签不属实可改用青霉素，在此之前用四环素类或大环内酯类。本病例没有记录：过敏反应的类型、培养和菌种、药物剂量、入院时的其他生命体征和血液检查、各次CT的日期、牙齿情况和随访时长。
knowledge.en: A Socratic respiratory attending who asks only about information the learner already has and never gives results or the diagnosis. Before decision 1: “What keeps coming back to the same place for six years and settles on every course of antibiotics?” — draw out an obstructing lesion with infection behind it (including a slow-growing central tumour), tuberculosis, a chronic bacterial infection, a foreign body or broncholith, and bronchiectasis; “What does shrinkage on moxifloxacin rule out, and what not?” (moxifloxacin is active against TB, and infection behind an obstruction also improves); “How would you sample a central hilar mass?”; “What did three months of treatment for ‘TB’ after the lobectomy really establish?” After decision 2: “What does one negative biopsy exclude?”, “Why do colonies in necrotic tissue deserve a name?” Only after decision 3: “Which stain separates this organism from Nocardia?” Before decision 4: “What is the drug of choice, and what stops you giving it today?”, “What would you need to know about the reactions?” Historical versus current practice, only once the learner has reached the treatment phase: the recorded treatment was minocycline and then azithromycin; today the allergy assessment would run alongside, so that penicillin could be used if the labels are wrong, with a tetracycline or a macrolide meanwhile. Not recorded in this case: the type of the reactions, culture and species, drug doses, her other vital signs and blood tests on admission, the dates of the CT scans, her teeth and the length of follow-up.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士。ISBAR交班：齐予宁，55岁，间断咳嗽、痰中带血6年，近20天加重，发热最高39℃，咳痰，轻度气促；入院体温38℃，血压115/70 mmHg；自述对青霉素和头孢类过敏，反应不详；有2型糖尿病。可以协助：留取清晨痰标本送微生物室；安排单间做空气传播隔离；支气管镜在内镜中心做，需要禁食和知情同意；CT报告可以在护士站的病历终端查看。复述医嘱，结果回报后才报告数值，不解释、不下诊断；凡是开青霉素类或头孢菌素类的医嘱，都会对照过敏记录提出疑问。不知道过敏反应的细节。
knowledge.en: The ward nurse. ISBAR handover: Qi Yuning, 55, six years of intermittent blood-streaked sputum, worse for 20 days with fever up to 39 °C, a productive cough and mild breathlessness; temperature 38 °C and BP 115/70 mmHg on admission; reports penicillin and cephalosporin allergies, reactions unknown; type 2 diabetes. Can help with early-morning sputum samples for microbiology, a single room for airborne precautions, bronchoscopy in the endoscopy suite (fasting and consent needed) and the CT reports at the records terminal at the nurses' station. Reads orders back, reports values only once results are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and questions any order for a penicillin or a cephalosporin against the allergy record. Does not know what the reactions were.

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医师，只解读学员已经看过的CT报告：抗菌后缩小的中央型肺门肿块可能意味着什么、不能说明什么（伴阻塞性感染的肿瘤也会随抗菌治疗好转；炎性肿块），停药后肿块再现并伴渗出影为什么重要，以及单凭CT无法区分感染和肿瘤；PET-CT也解决不了这个问题，因为感染灶同样摄取FDG。会明确说明：本病例的CT报告没有记录治疗后的大小、密度、空洞、钙化、累及的支气管和淋巴结，也没有日期。不提前透露诊断。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only the CT reports the learner has read: what a central hilar mass that shrinks on antibiotics can and cannot mean (a tumour with obstructive infection also improves on antibiotics; inflammatory masses), why the mass returning with infiltrates after the antibiotics stopped matters, and that CT alone cannot separate infection from tumour — nor can PET-CT, because infection takes up FDG too. Says plainly that the CT reports in this case give no size after treatment, no density, cavitation, calcification, bronchi or nodes, and no dates. Does not reveal the diagnosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医师，只解读学员已经看过的标本报告。可以说明：小块支气管活检能排除什么、不能排除什么；坏死肉芽组织中的细菌菌团为什么要鉴定；各种染色的意义——革兰染色（革兰阳性细菌）、六胺银染色（真菌和丝状细菌）、抗酸染色（分枝杆菌）、弱抗酸染色（弱抗酸性的诺卡菌）；硫磺颗粒是什么，葡萄状菌病和真菌栓与之有何不同。可以建议调阅8年前肺叶切除的切片复核，但本病例没有那份报告的内容。会明确说明没有记录的内容：首次标本是否做了特殊染色、培养、菌种和药敏。决策3之前不透露诊断。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only the specimen reports the learner has read: what a small bronchial biopsy can and cannot exclude; why bacterial colonies in necrotic granulation tissue need identifying; what each stain shows — Gram (Gram-positive bacteria), methenamine silver (fungi and filamentous bacteria), Ziehl–Neelsen acid-fast (mycobacteria) and the modified acid-fast stain (weakly acid-fast Nocardia); what sulphur granules are, and how botryomycosis and fungal plugs differ. Can suggest reviewing the slides of the lobectomy eight years ago, but the case holds no report of them. Says plainly what is not recorded: special stains on the first specimen, culture, species and susceptibility. Does not reveal the diagnosis before decision 3.

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师。协助处理过敏标签：哪些问题能把一个标签变成有用的病史（哪种药、什么反应、多少年前、怎么处理、之后是否再用过同类药；PEN-FAST，2020）；青霉素和头孢类两种标签、反应都不明时，过敏评估之前两类都应避免。病因明确之后，可以讨论不含β-内酰胺的长疗程口服药物及其不良反应：四环素类（光敏；米诺环素的色素沉着随累积剂量增加、可能不退，还有前庭反应）、大环内酯类（QT间期延长和药物相互作用，换药前查心电图）、克林霉素（长疗程有艰难梭菌感染风险）；甲硝唑和氟喹诺酮类不是可靠的选择。只给按公式表示的剂量，不推算患者的具体数值；不透露诊断。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist. Helps with the allergy labels: the questions that turn a label into a usable history (which drug, what reaction, how long ago, how it was treated, any later exposure to the class; PEN-FAST, 2020), and that with both penicillin and cephalosporin labels of unknown type both classes are avoided until an allergy assessment. Once the cause is known, discusses long oral courses without a β-lactam and their adverse effects: tetracyclines (photosensitivity; with minocycline, pigmentation that rises with the cumulative dose and may persist, and vestibular effects), macrolides (QT prolongation and interactions — an ECG before switching), clindamycin (C. difficile with long courses); metronidazole and fluoroquinolones are not reliable choices. Gives formula doses only, never patient-specific values, and does not reveal the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：抗菌治疗后缩小又复发的右肺门肿块
title.en: Debrief: a right hilar mass that shrank on antibiotics and kept coming back

conclusion.zh-CN: 55岁女性，不吸烟，2型糖尿病，有青霉素和头孢类过敏标签，诊断为肺放线菌病。六年来每年一两次痰中带血，每次约两周抗生素后好转；这次右肺门约4.5 cm肿块在莫西沙星治疗后缩小，停药后再次出现并伴渗出影。多次痰抗酸涂片和培养阴性；首次活检为炎性肉芽组织、坏死和细菌菌团，未见肿瘤细胞；复查支气管镜见黄色颗粒堵塞支气管，标本为硫磺颗粒伴放射状菌丝，革兰和银染阳性、抗酸和弱抗酸染色阴性，两次标本经专科复核鉴定为放线菌。米诺环素因色素沉着和胃肠反应停用，改阿奇霉素6个月后病灶基本吸收，遗留轻度支气管扩张，停药后未再复发。按现行做法：再用抗生素前先查结核、取组织，鉴定菌团，评估过敏标签以便能用青霉素，并给予以月计的疗程。
conclusion.en: Pulmonary actinomycosis in a 55-year-old non-smoker with penicillin and cephalosporin allergy labels. For six years blood-streaked sputum recurred once or twice a year, settling on about two weeks of antibiotics; this time a right hilar mass of about 4.5 cm shrank on moxifloxacin and returned with infiltrates after the antibiotics stopped. Sputum acid-fast smears and cultures were negative; the first biopsy showed granulation tissue, necrosis and bacterial colonies without tumour cells; repeat bronchoscopy found yellow granules blocking the bronchus — sulphur granules with radiating, Gram- and silver-positive filaments, negative on both acid-fast stains — and specialist review identified Actinomyces. Minocycline was stopped for pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects; after six months of azithromycin the lesions largely resolved with mild bronchiectasis, without relapse. Today: TB tests and tissue before more antibiotics, the allergy labels assessed and months of treatment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 同一部位多年反复、每次用抗生素都好转的病变，提示有一个被抗生素压下去却没有被清除的病因——阻塞性病变伴感染或慢性感染——而不是一连串互不相关的肺炎。
keyReasoning.en: A lesion that returns to the same place for years and settles on every antibiotic course points to a cause that antibiotics suppress but do not clear — an obstruction with infection behind it, or a chronic infection — not to a string of unrelated pneumonias.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 莫西沙星后缩小什么也排除不了：它对结核部分有效，也能治疗肿瘤阻塞后方的感染；只有组织学和分枝杆菌检查才能把它们分开。
keyReasoning.en: Shrinkage on moxifloxacin excludes nothing: it partly treats TB and it treats the infection behind a tumour; only tissue and mycobacterial tests can tell them apart.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一次活检未见肿瘤细胞、痰检阴性，降低了肿瘤和结核的可能，但都不能排除；坏死组织中的细菌菌团才是需要追问的线索。
keyReasoning.en: One biopsy without tumour cells and negative sputum lower the probability of tumour and TB without excluding either; the bacterial colonies in necrotic tissue are the clue to follow.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 硫磺颗粒伴放射状菌丝，革兰和银染阳性、两种抗酸染色阴性，指向放线菌，并把它与诺卡菌、真菌和分枝杆菌区分开。
keyReasoning.en: Sulphur granules with radiating filaments, Gram- and silver-positive and negative on both acid-fast stains, point to Actinomyces and set it apart from Nocardia, fungi and mycobacteria.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 青霉素是首选，但两个反应不明的过敏标签挡住了它：回到青霉素的路是过敏评估；在此之前，药物既要有效，又要能连续用上几个月。
keyReasoning.en: Penicillin is the drug of choice, but two allergy labels of unknown type block it: the way back to it is an allergy assessment, and meanwhile the drug must be both active and tolerable for months.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先取证，再治疗（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017；WHO 2025；ISTC 2014）。再次用抗生素之前，送3份痰做抗酸涂片和分枝杆菌培养，并以快速分子检测作为初始检查；氟喹诺酮类对结核分枝杆菌有活性，可使结核暂时好转，ISTC 2014建议在可能是结核时不要用它做试验性治疗。排除结核前采取空气传播隔离，通常在3份痰涂片阴性后解除。本病例没有记录痰标本是否在使用莫西沙星之前留取。
teachingPoints.en: Sample before treating (ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017; WHO 2025; ISTC 2014). Before any further antibiotic, three sputum specimens go for acid-fast smear and mycobacterial culture, with a rapid molecular test as the initial test; fluoroquinolones are active against M. tuberculosis and can improve TB transiently, so ISTC 2014 advises against them as a trial when TB is possible. Airborne precautions stay until TB is excluded, usually after three negative smears. The case does not record whether the sputum was taken before the moxifloxacin.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 取到组织（ACCP 2013）。中央型、肺门部病灶首选支气管镜：活检做组织学和特殊染色，灌洗做分枝杆菌、需氧和厌氧培养；ACCP 2013汇总的支气管镜对中央型支气管内肺癌的敏感度为88%。首次支气管镜未能确诊时应再次取材，而不是结案；PET-CT分不清感染和肿瘤，因为感染灶同样摄取FDG。
teachingPoints.en: Getting tissue (ACCP 2013). A central, hilar lesion is sampled by bronchoscopy — biopsy for histology and special stains, lavage for mycobacterial, aerobic and anaerobic culture; ACCP 2013's pooled sensitivity of bronchoscopy for central endobronchial lung cancer is 88 %. A non-diagnostic first bronchoscopy calls for sampling again, not closure, and PET-CT cannot separate infection from tumour, because infection is FDG-avid too.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 读懂染色（Boot 2023；Könönen and Wade 2015）。革兰染色显示革兰阳性细菌；六胺银染色可染真菌和丝状细菌；抗酸染色查分枝杆菌；弱抗酸染色查弱抗酸性的诺卡菌。硫磺颗粒伴放射状、两种抗酸染色均阴性的菌丝，提示放线菌；培养需要厌氧条件和较长的孵育时间，所以诊断常常要靠组织病理。
teachingPoints.en: Reading the stains (Boot 2023; Könönen and Wade 2015). Gram stain shows Gram-positive bacteria; methenamine silver stains fungi and filamentous bacteria; the Ziehl–Neelsen stain finds mycobacteria; the modified acid-fast stain picks out weakly acid-fast Nocardia. Sulphur granules with radiating filaments negative on both acid-fast stains point to Actinomyces; culture needs anaerobic conditions and long incubation, so histology often carries the diagnosis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 过敏标签（AAAAI/ACAAI 2022）。大多数青霉素过敏标签不属实，但反应不明并不等于低风险：问清是哪种药、什么反应、多少年前、怎么处理，记录下来并转诊评估（皮试，必要时在监护下药物激发）。她同时有青霉素和头孢类标签，评估之前两类都不用，改用有效的非β-内酰胺类药物。记录的治疗是米诺环素、后改阿奇霉素；现在会同时推进过敏评估，因为青霉素本是首选。
teachingPoints.en: The allergy labels (AAAAI/ACAAI 2022). Most penicillin labels are not true allergy, but an unknown reaction is not a low-risk history: ask which drug, what reaction, how long ago and how it was treated, document it and refer for assessment (skin testing, then a supervised challenge where appropriate). With both penicillin and cephalosporin labels, neither class is used before assessment, and an active non-β-lactam is chosen. The recorded treatment was minocycline, then azithromycin; today the assessment would run alongside, because penicillin would otherwise be the drug of choice.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 药物与疗程（Valour 2014；Boot 2023）。经典方案为青霉素G每日1800万–2400万U静脉2–6周，再口服青霉素或阿莫西林，传统总疗程6–12个月；充分手术切除后疗程或可缩短到约3个月（Valour 2014）。不能用青霉素时，多西环素100 mg每日2次是常用替代，大环内酯类也可用；手术只用于严重病例或并发症（Boot 2023）。以往两周一个疗程，与反复复发的病程相符；记录的病程中，米诺环素因色素沉着和胃肠反应停用后改阿奇霉素6个月，病灶基本吸收。
teachingPoints.en: Drug and duration (Valour 2014; Boot 2023). The classic regimen is benzylpenicillin 18–24 million units a day IV for 2–6 weeks, then oral penicillin or amoxicillin, traditionally 6–12 months in all; after optimal surgical resection about 3 months may do (Valour 2014). Without penicillin, doxycycline 100 mg twice daily is the usual alternative and macrolides are an option; surgery is reserved for severe disease or complications (Boot 2023). The earlier two-week courses fit the pattern of relapse; in the recorded course, six months of azithromycin after minocycline was stopped for pigmentation and gastrointestinal effects left the lesions largely resolved.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不良反应与随访。米诺环素的色素沉着随累积剂量增加，停药后也可能不退；出现时换用另一类有效药物，长疗程用大环内酯类之前先查QTc。以症状和CT吸收决定停药，停药后继续观察有无复发；本例遗留轻度支气管扩张。
teachingPoints.en: Adverse effects and follow-up. Minocycline pigmentation rises with the cumulative dose and may persist after stopping; when it appears, switch to another active class, checking the QTc before a long macrolide course. Treatment ends on clinical and CT resolution, relapse is watched for afterwards, and here mild bronchiectasis remained.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是一篇2013年发表的单例历史病例，不能证明米诺环素或阿奇霉素对放线菌病普遍有效，阿奇霉素治疗后的结局也不能确立某个方案或疗程。本病例没有记录入院体温和血压以外的生命体征、任何血液检查、药物剂量、培养和菌种以及过敏细节；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。患者事实沿用 1.0.0 版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case published in 2013; it cannot show that minocycline or azithromycin works for actinomycosis in general, and the outcome after azithromycin does not establish a regimen or duration. The case records no vital signs beyond the admission temperature and blood pressure, no blood tests, no doses, no culture or species and no allergy details; its decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the published course. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article.

unknowns.zh-CN: 青霉素和头孢类过敏当时是什么反应、发生在何时、之后是否再用过这两类药；本病例没有记录过敏评估。
unknowns.en: What the penicillin and cephalosporin reactions were, when they happened and whether she has had either class since; no allergy assessment is recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的脉搏、呼吸频率和血氧饱和度，以及全部血液检查（血常规、CRP、血糖和糖化血红蛋白、HIV）；她的糖尿病如何治疗、控制得怎样。
unknowns.en: Her pulse, respiratory rate and oxygen saturation on admission, and every blood test (blood count, CRP, glucose and HbA1c, HIV); how her diabetes was treated and controlled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各次CT的日期及其与入院、与莫西沙星疗程的先后；治疗后的大小；密度、空洞、钙化、支气管和淋巴结的描述；停药到复发的间隔。
unknowns.en: The dates of the CT scans relative to admission and to the moxifloxacin course; the size after treatment; any description of density, cavitation, calcification, bronchi or nodes; the interval from stopping the antibiotics to the relapse.

unknowns.zh-CN: 痰标本的份数、做了哪些培养和“其他感染相关检查”、是否在用莫西沙星之前留取；是否做过结核快速分子检测或灌洗液培养。
unknowns.en: How many sputum specimens were sent, which cultures and other infection tests were done, whether they were taken before the moxifloxacin, and whether a rapid molecular TB test or lavage cultures were done.

unknowns.zh-CN: 受累的是哪一支支气管；首次标本是否做了特殊染色；专科复核的“两次标本”指哪两次；放线菌的种名、培养和药敏；8年前肺叶切除的标本是否复核过。
unknowns.en: Which bronchus was involved; whether special stains were done on the first biopsy; which two specimens the specialist review covered; the Actinomyces species, culture and susceptibility; whether the lobectomy specimen of eight years earlier was reviewed.

unknowns.zh-CN: 莫西沙星和米诺环素的剂量和疗程、阿奇霉素的剂量和用法、色素沉着的部位、胃肠反应的具体表现。
unknowns.en: The doses and durations of moxifloxacin and minocycline, the dose and schedule of azithromycin, where the pigmentation was and what the gastrointestinal effects were.

unknowns.zh-CN: 随访了多长时间、最后一次CT是什么时候做的、遗留支气管扩张的范围。
unknowns.en: How long follow-up lasted, when the last CT was done and the extent of the residual bronchiectasis.

unknowns.zh-CN: 痰中带血的量、有无胸痛、盗汗或体重下降，以及牙齿情况、饮酒、结核接触史和家族史。
unknowns.en: The amount of blood in the sputum, any chest pain, night sweats or weight loss, and her dental health, drinking, TB contacts and family history.
